cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.

mechanism: A controls arrangements for a meeting by interpreting the partner's attempted repair as the inevitable breakup script.
confusable: Unlike neutral planning, A authorizes the plan only after classifying it as evidence the feared ending is underway.
comparison: A cancelled lunch and choice of public table differ from accepting illness care as farewell.
seedUse: Retain cancellation, exhaustion and rescheduling from D120; make S01 control how the presumed breakup may be staged.
